testimonials.name: Pooja Sharma
testimonials.review: Booked Dezire Decore for my daughter's 5th birthday. The pastel balloon arch was breathtaking! They arrived right on time and did not leave a single tape mark on our wall.

testimonials.name: Rohit Verma
testimonials.review: Ordered the midnight anniversary canopy surprise for my wife. The lighting, rose petals, and balloon ceiling looked straight out of Pinterest. Highly recommended in Ghaziabad!

testimonials.name: Meenakshi Tyagi
testimonials.review: Super professional team. They managed the entire Welcome Baby decor on just 3 hours notice when we were returning from the hospital. Outstanding service and reasonable price.

testimonials.name: Amit Saxena
testimonials.review: Hired them for our new clinic inauguration balloon gate and stage backdrop. Clean finishing, high quality chrome balloons that stayed inflated for 3 days.
